description: Defines the FileID class for generating and handling unique file identifiers, including methods for extracting identifiers from ELF files and converting them to string format.

classes.name: FileID
classes.description: Class for creating and managing unique identifiers for files, especially ELF files, with methods to extract identifiers and convert them to string format.

methods.name: FileID
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FileID object with a file path.

methods.name: ElfFileIdentifier
methods.description: Loads the ELF file identifier into the provided buffer, returning success status.

methods.name: ElfFileIdentifierFromMappedFile
methods.description: Static method to extract ELF file identifier from a memory-mapped file.

methods.name: ConvertIdentifierToString
methods.description: Static method to convert a binary identifier into a UUID string format.
